summary.text: John Alcala is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 57 who has represented the district since January 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: John Alcala took office in the Kansas House of Representatives on January 14, 2013.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture and Natural Resources Budget, Appropriations, Taxation, State-Tribal Relations and State Building Construction committees.
